# Vercelian

> Vercelian is a native Mac app that shows your Vercel deployments live in the menu bar and alerts you the moment a build fails. It's open source under the MIT license, has no accounts, analytics, or tracking, and keeps your Vercel access token in the macOS Keychain.

Vercelian is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Vercel Inc.

- Platform: macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- License: MIT
- Install: download Vercelian.zip from the latest GitHub release; a Mac App Store version is coming soon
- Sign-in: paste a Vercel access token created at https://vercel.com/account/tokens
- Network: the app talks only to Vercel's API (api.vercel.com); it has no server of its own

## Pages

- [Vercelian](https://vercelian.co/index.md): what the app does, its features, and how to set it up
- [Privacy Policy](https://vercelian.co/privacy.md): what the app keeps on your Mac and what it sends to Vercel
